method: Official Steam Store appdetails endpoint was queried live; official first screenshots were downloaded and visually inspected. Store descriptions were read. Existing cached trailer-frame records were reused only where stated. No audio was listened to. Still frames do not establish animation timing.

references.title: Luck be a Landlord
references.official_source: Steam Store appdetails and official store screenshots
references.observed_medium: Live official appdetails + first official gameplay screenshot inspected; official 100.104 s Release Date Trailer downloaded; 5 s excerpt 18.0–23.0 s sampled at 2 fps and visually inspected (luck-gameplay-18-23s-frames.jpg). Separate 2.3 s embedded muted store loop was sampled and found to be a title animation.
references.evidence: The page calls it a slot-machine roguelike and says the player inserts a coin into the slot machine; screenshot shows a multi-column symbol reel layout and a prominent SPIN control. The embedded 2.3 s loop is a promotional title animation over changing symbol art, not a gameplay spin. It does not show a wheel/reel stop or payout.
references.supports: Relevant thematic primary source for symbol-board affordance and post-spin symbol/coin value readout. The sampled trailer demonstrates state changes across edited shots, but not a continuous spin-and-stop.
references.does_not_establish: No continuous reel animation, acceleration, staggered stops, outcome-reveal cadence, or sound can be verified from this excerpt. No audio listened.
references.adaptation: Keep the 9-zone board fixed; add one short, readable spin phase and sequential candidate lock only if each stop remains visually tied to its board cell. Keep actual outcome private until reveal.
references.observed_sequence: In the 18–23 s trailer excerpt, the edited footage shows an Add a symbol choice panel, then a 5-column symbol board with SPIN button; several subsequent shots show different fixed symbol layouts, followed by coin markers on symbols and updated coin counters. Frames are sample stills from an edited trailer; the shots include cuts.

references.title: Balatro
references.official_source: Steam Store appdetails and official store screenshot; cached official trailer samples from prior research
references.observed_medium: Live official appdetails and first screenshot; official 38.667 s Steam Accolades Gameplay Video downloaded; 6 s excerpt 4.0–10.0 s sampled at 2 fps and visually inspected (balatro-gameplay-04-10s-frames.jpg). Cached 6-frame observations are also retained as prior context.
references.evidence: Current store copy describes poker-hand combinations, scoring chips, blinds and Joker synergies. Screenshot shows a stable result composition: played cards, hand label, score multiplier and run controls in distinct regions. Cached trailer does not constitute continuous animation evidence.
references.supports: A useful adjacent reference for keeping the selected hand and result label visible while score feedback resolves.
references.does_not_establish: No roulette/spin or zone-lock mechanic; no measured animation timing; no audio analyzed.
references.adaptation: After the spin, present the selected zone and its real outcome in a stable, legible state. Never animate a success payout before the result is actually resolved.
references.observed_sequence: In sampled trailer frames, a fixed five-card hand and Straight label are visible while multiplier/score presentation changes; the label Balanced appears as the score presentation settles. The promo edit cuts between gameplay and testimonial/award panels; this is not one uninterrupted play sequence.

references.title: Dicey Dungeons
references.official_source: Steam Store appdetails and official first screenshot
references.observed_medium: Current official store description + first official screenshot directly inspected
references.evidence: Screenshot presents dice faces and multiple action cards with distinct requirements/effects, including a visible 'roll a dice' style action context. Store copy explicitly frames strategic decisions against the unknown of a dice roll.
references.supports: Random resolution can be framed by an explicit pre-result choice and a readable post-roll state.
references.does_not_establish: Screenshot cannot verify dice animation, stopping behavior, timing, or sound. Not a roulette reference.
references.adaptation: Use a calm ready state before spin and a visually distinct locked state after each meaningful reveal; keep controls and result labels outside the 3x3 board.

references.title: Peggle Deluxe
references.official_source: Steam Store appdetails and official first screenshot
references.observed_medium: Current official store description + first official screenshot directly inspected
references.evidence: Store copy says aim, shoot, clear orange pegs, then cheer; the screenshot shows a ball path through a peg field and a localized 'EXTREME SLIDE'/'EXCELLENT' score callout near a result area.
references.supports: A traversing object and a clear end-of-action result can create anticipation before reward.
references.does_not_establish: Still image does not prove ball trajectory, final-peg event timing, animation duration, or audio.
references.adaptation: Borrow the anticipation arc in miniature: make the spinning marker approach a candidate zone, then pause briefly at the actual stop. Avoid covering cells with a large callout.

references.title: Vampire Survivors
references.official_source: Steam Store appdetails and official first screenshot; cached official trailer samples from prior research
references.observed_medium: Live official appdetails and first screenshot; official Refreshed Trailer 3 s opening excerpt downloaded and sampled at 2 fps (vampire-official-opening-excerpt-frames.jpg); cached 6-frame observations from prior research.
references.evidence: Store description identifies time-survival gameplay and choice-driven progression; screenshot shows a dense combat field with player, enemies and effects competing for attention. Cached samples include static frames and do not establish chest opening animation.
references.supports: Use as a caution: preserve a distinct focal object and keep effects local when motion is present.
references.does_not_establish: No chest opening, slot stop, payoff sequence, or sound observed.
references.adaptation: Keep the spinner and candidate cells visually singular; use one localized stop cue instead of adding confetti across the board.
references.observed_sequence: The short opening excerpt shows the character stationary in a field while small projectiles/effects appear and travel around it across successive frames. This is action feedback, not treasure chest or roulette resolution.

references.title: Tetris Effect: Connected
references.official_source: Steam Store appdetails and official first screenshot
references.observed_medium: Current official store description + first official screenshot directly inspected
references.evidence: The store description says music, backgrounds, sounds, effects and tetrominoes pulse and change in sync with play. Screenshot shows a centered playfield with bright ambient detail surrounding it.
references.supports: The official description supports coordinated audiovisual response as a design direction, while the centered board remains the focal point.
references.does_not_establish: No audio was played and the screenshot does not prove specific sound cues, sync timing, or stop cadence.
references.adaptation: Tie a short visual pulse to the true lock event; if adding sound, treat it as a proposal pending listening and accessibility checks.

references.title: Hades
references.official_source: Steam Store appdetails and official first screenshot
references.observed_medium: Current official store description + first official screenshot directly inspected
references.evidence: Screenshot shows combat with a bright localized attack/impact shape on a readable arena floor. Store copy describes action combat and boon choices, not a roulette wheel.
references.supports: A compact contact flash can read against a relatively stable field, and choice presentation can be distinct from action.
references.does_not_establish: Not a spin/lock reference; no sampled impact timing or audio claim.
references.adaptation: Use only the localized contact contrast as a secondary inspiration; do not import combat-scale camera shake or effects into the board.

candidate_note: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe was replaced by Hades as an accessible official Steam-source adjacent reference; the accessible evidence set is limited to Steam Store sources, and Hades is explicitly labeled as non-roulette inspiration. No Mario Kart-specific behavior is claimed.
